retrievalProfile.description: A vibrant, psychedelic cartoon style featuring a central character with dreadlocks in front of a dense, surreal crowd and a cosmic background.
triggerTerms: trippy vector illustration with cosmic background
vibrant cel-shaded character art with surreal crowd

recipe.visualDefinition: A high-energy, saturated digital illustration featuring a central punk-inspired character with dreadlocks and tattoos, set against a dense crowd of surreal, multi-eyed creatures. The scene is topped with a cosmic purple nebula sky and a smiling, ringed planet.
coreVisualRelationships: Central figure dominates the foreground with a direct, expressive gaze.
Dense, overlapping crowd creates a wall of texture behind the subject.
Cosmic elements in the upper third provide a sense of scale and surrealism.
Vibrant, high-contrast colors unify the disparate character designs.
coreInvariants: Thick, consistent black outlines on all characters and objects.
Saturated, neon-leaning color palette with heavy use of purple and pink.
Surreal, multi-eyed character designs throughout the crowd.

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Central character is large-scale, positioned in the middle foreground from the waist up.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The central character's face and expressive eyes serve as the primary anchor.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Eyes move from the central figure up to the title text, then across to the smiling planet, and down into the detailed crowd.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Minimal negative space; the composition is densely packed with detail.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Deep purple and magenta nebula sky.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Bright yellow and lime green accents on clothing and accessories.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Rainbow gradients within the planet's rings and character features.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High saturation across all elements with deep black shadows for depth.
paletteRestrictions: Maintain high contrast between foreground and background

letterConstructionRules: Heavy italicization for a sense of speed
Internal glow and outer stroke effects
characterSpecificRedesigns: Letters feature internal textures resembling cosmic energy or static.
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Single expressive display style to maintain focus on the artwork.

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the aggressive, hand-drawn energy of the original.
Aligns with the streetwear and urban aesthetic.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a vibrant psychedelic illustration of a central punk character with dreadlocks in front of a dense crowd of surreal, multi-eyed monsters under a purple nebula sky with a smiling ringed planet.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add custom hand-drawn, jagged, slanted display text in the top left corner with a pink-to-white gradient fill and a thick black outline.

verificationChecks: Text has a visible outer glow
Text does not obscure the central character's face

mustRedesign: Unique monster designs in the crowd
postGenerationChecks: Are the outlines thick and consistent?
Is the color palette vibrant and high-contrast?
Is the crowd sufficiently dense and surreal?
Does the text feel integrated into the psychedelic style?
recipe.reuseFormula: Combine a central punk-style character with a 'horror-vacui' style crowd of surreal creatures and a cosmic, neon-lit background.
